query:
-- Check senate races called tonight
SELECT state_code, called_winner, called_party, primary_winner, primary_party, status FROM senate_races 
WHERE (called_winner IS NOT NULL OR primary_winner IS NOT NULL) 
AND state_code NOT IN (SELECT state_code FROM broadcast_log WHERE election_date = '2026-05-19' AND chamber = 'senate')
LIMIT 10;

-- Check house races called tonight that aren't in broadcast_log
SELECT state_code, district, called_winner, called_party, primary_winner, primary_party, status FROM house_races 
WHERE (called_winner IS NOT NULL OR primary_winner IS NOT NULL) 
LIMIT 5;
